run_quantization_oneshot: run the llmcompressor oneshot API to quantize a model with AutoRound and KV cache quantization
create_dataset_get_dataset: create a calibration dataset using auto_round get_dataset with a tokenizer, sequence length, and sample count
load_model_autogeneration: load a causal language model and tokenizer from transformers AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer
test_model_generation: test the quantized model by dispatching it and generating text with the tokenizer and model.generate
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk with save_pretrained and save_compressed
